name: Aether-Grid Prime
tagline: When humanity's inner light turns volatile, the grid demands an absolute reckoning.
style: A high-contrast digital comic aesthetic featuring heavy ink shadows combined with vibrant, neon-lit particle effects. Characters are rendered with sharp, cinematic proportions and detailed textures that mimic screen-printed grain under dynamic street-level lighting.
setting: Oakhaven Metropolis: A sprawling, coastal megacity where glittering spire-like architecture sits directly above crumbling industrial undercities, bound together by volatile ambient-energy networks and neon-drenched skyways.
themes: The heavy cost of vigilante responsibility
The volatile human emotion behind extraordinary power

heroes.name: Prism-Guard
heroes.powers: Refracts ambient light into solid geometry shield-barriers and focused laser grids
heroes.personality: Stoic, analytical, and deeply protective of civilians
heroes.visual: A 32-year-old East Asian man with sharp cheekbones and short, neatly cropped black hair. He has an athletic build and olive skin. Costume features an angular, matte-navy armored jumpsuit with bright turquoise hexagonal plates across the chest. Displays a stylized three-tiered pyramid emblem glowing soft white. No cape. Wears silver-rimmed visor goggles.
heroes.weakness: Total light deprivation renders his constructs fragile and unstable.

heroes.name: Fracture-Shock
heroes.powers: Manipulates localized kinetic vibration to shatter matter or propel herself
heroes.personality: Brash, impulsive, and fiercely passionate about social justice
heroes.visual: A 24-year-old Afro-Latina woman with a muscular frame, warm bronze skin, and tight amber-dyed undercut braids. Wears a asymmetrical dark-magenta leather jacket over a high-neck charcoal body-glove. Her emblem is a broken lightning bolt inside a yellow circle. Features thick brass gauntlets on both forearms. No cape. Wears dark combat boots.
heroes.weakness: Excessive kinetic buildup causes internal muscular hemorrhaging.

heroes.name: Aura-Splicer
heroes.powers: Temporarily weaves and cuts the emotional energy fields of living targets
heroes.personality: Empathetic, soft-spoken, but plagued by intense existential dread
heroes.visual: A 45-year-old Caucasian man with pale skin, a slim tall frame, silver-streaked brown hair tied in a low ponytail, and a trimmed beard. Attired in a flowing, midnight-violet tailored longcoat that functions as a cape. Coat displays a glowing mint-green caduceus-loop emblem. Wears white lace-up hand wraps and dark trousers.
heroes.weakness: Absorbing too much hostile emotion triggers temporary sensory paralysis.

heroes.name: Tide-Vault
heroes.powers: Compresses dense atmospheric moisture into heavy hydraulic projectiles
heroes.personality: Methodical, cool-headed, and intensely focused under extreme pressure
heroes.visual: A 28-year-old West African woman with deep dark skin, tall imposing stature, and long dreadlocks swept to one side. Wears a streamlined white and coral-orange aquatic armor with reinforced shoulder pauldrons. Chest features a wave-shaped teal crest emblem. Attached short translucent-blue shoulder cape. Equips heavy silver ankle braces.
heroes.weakness: Arid climates severely restrict her offensive output.

villains.name: Malice-Core
villains.powers: Generates bio-corrosive radiation that melts solid structures and drains electricity
villains.visual: A hulking cybernetic figure wrapped in rusted iron plating with exposed glowing lime-green tubes. Features a jagged faceless metal helmet and massive spiked shoulders.
villains.motive: To collapse the city power grid and force humanity back into a chaotic dark age.

villains.name: Null-Stitch
villains.powers: Weaves shadow threads that bind heroic abilities and erase physical memories
villains.visual: A tall slender silhouette draped in a tattered obsidian cloak with porcelain mask. Long, needle-like silver metallic fingers twitch constantly.
villains.motive: To erase the public memory of superheroism and instill absolute cynicism.

villains.name: Cinder-Grip
villains.powers: Converts ambient oxygen into dense, superheated thermal plasma trails
villains.visual: A broad-shouldered man in a scorched soot-gray exosuit with flaming red exhausts on his back and a glowing orange skull respirator faceplate.
villains.motive: To burn away modern civilization to clear space for his mercenary faction.

villains.name: Silt-Spire
villains.powers: Transmutes concrete and steel into razor-sharp, shifting quicksand spikes
villains.visual: A gaunt figure wearing dusty terracotta-colored robes fused with jagged stone armor pieces. Eyes glow bright yellow beneath a heavy cloth hood.
villains.motive: Reclaiming the metropolitan landscape for pristine, uninhabited earth.

episodes.title: Prism-Guard Faces a Corrosive End Against the Brutal Malice-Core
